description: Klone brings Swift Package Manager-style git dependency management to Android and Gradle. Declare library dependencies by GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket URL directly in build.gradle.kts using gitImplementation(). Klone clones the repo, auto-detects its Gradle modules, and wires everything up as a Composite Build — no binary publishing required. Supports tags, branches, and exact commits. Works with private repos. Apply io.github.dev-jackson.klone in settings.gradle.kts and io.github.dev-jackson.klone.project in your module.
